title.zh: 生成即补充：体现的关系项的生起本身需要补充；在耗散之下，它在有限家族中复现时家族不封闭，家族被围住时从其外汲入
title.en: Generation is replenishment: the arising of an embodied relatum itself needs replenishment, and under dissipation a finite family in which it recurs is not closed and, enclosed around, draws in from beyond it

claim.zh: 以一类关系项读依存网与流。在平衡的流中，一个体现的关系项至少被给予它生起时的水平：生起前它不活跃，所以水平为零；生起后它活跃，所以水平为正。于是它的生起补充每个包含它的家族；一个家族的体现成员在任意晚的步生起时，家族的补充在任意晚的步出现，不论取用什么。生成在这里本身承担要求，不经由它带来的取用。给予一个被耗散家族的形成从家族取用，所以一个被耗散的家族中体现成员的生起降低家族的存量，在耗散之下跨某步封闭的不重复家族正是如此；从某步起被耗散的家族中，体现成员不在任意晚的步生起（generation_ceases_on）。所以在耗散之下，体现成员在任意晚的步生起的不重复有限家族，从任何一步起都不封闭：在任意晚的步有参与的形成与其外交换（generation_opens）。这一交换可以与家族无关：一个汇与不断新的关系项交换时，没有一步被封闭，耗散空成立，生成在两方的家族中复现而没有任何东西流入，汇使家族不封闭（SprayShuttle）。家族从某步起被围住（某个包含它的不重复有限家族跨每步封闭）时，它汲入：在任意晚的步，有关系项给予家族而从家族之外取用（generation_draws_in）。有限个关系项就是全部时，体现的关系项不在任意晚的步生起。于是 dissipation_ceases 的前提（一个量从不上升，每次生起都使它下降），对被耗散家族中体现成员的生起，由平衡、耗散与体现推出。每个前提都必要：两方来回传递一份水平，在两个关系项的封闭世界中体现地、不息地生成，而不耗散（Shuttle）；持有者每步另燃一份新的燃料时，传递在耗散之下继续，包含一方的每个不重复有限家族在任意晚的步都不封闭，两方的家族每步被围住并汲入燃料（Throughput）；一个活动不是其水平的关系项，在一个关系项的耗散世界中不息地生起（Flicker）；只给予不取用的世代不耗散（Brood.not_dissipative）。这些要求跟着水平的上升走，不跟着活动走：在平衡的流中，任何条件的上升都被给予（Flow.Balances.rise_given），于是补充每个包含它的家族；一个家族的成员在任意晚的步上升时，家族的补充在任意晚的步出现（Flow.rising_needs_replenishment）。开始作为条件而在（此前水平为零，此后为正，Web.ComesToStand）是从零的上升（Web.ComesToStand.rises），至少被给予它的新水平（Flow.Balances.standing_given、Flow.standing_needs_replenishment）；一个条件可以每步上升而从不开始作为条件而在（Growing）。被耗散家族的成员上升，降低家族的存量（Flow.rise_lowers_on、Flow.standing_lowers_on），所以从某步起被耗散的家族中，成员不在任意晚的步上升，也不在任意晚的步开始作为条件而在（Flow.rising_ceases_on、Flow.standing_ceases_on）；在耗散之下，成员在任意晚的步上升的不重复有限家族在任意晚的步不封闭（Flow.rising_opens），从某步起被围住时汲入（Flow.rising_draws_in），有限个条件就是全部时没有条件在任意晚的步上升（Flow.rising_ceases）；开始作为条件而在是其情形（Web.rising_of_coming；Flow.standing_opens、Flow.standing_draws_in、Flow.standing_ceases）。体现的关系项在生起时开始作为条件而在（Embodied.comesToStand），上面关于体现的结论都由此推出，陈述不变。活跃时作为条件而在的关系项，若在某步不作为条件而在而后来活跃，就在其间某步开始作为条件而在（came_to_stand），可以早于活跃很久：种子在休眠时被给予它的水平，此后生起时没有任何给予（Provisioned）；一个始终作为条件而在的关系项不息地醒来，不需要任何给予，它的流中没有任何形成参与（Sleeper）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Read webs and flows with one kind of relatum. In a balanced flow an embodied relatum is given at least the standing it arises with: before it arises it is not active, so its level is zero, and after it is active, so its level is positive. Its arising therefore replenishes every family containing it, and where embodied members of a family arise at arbitrarily late steps, the family's replenishment recurs at arbitrarily late steps, whatever is taken. Here generation carries the requirement itself, not through the uptake it brings. A formation giving to a family dissipated on takes from it, so the arising of an embodied member of a family dissipated on lowers the family's stock, as under dissipation for a family without repetition closed across the step; in a family dissipated on from some step on, embodied members do not arise at arbitrarily late steps (generation_ceases_on). So under dissipation a finite family without repetition in which embodied members arise at arbitrarily late steps is not closed from any step on: at arbitrarily late steps some formation taking part exchanges with a relatum outside it (generation_opens). That exchange need not touch the family: with a sink exchanging with ever new relata, no step is enclosed, dissipation holds vacuously, and generation recurs in the family of two sides with nothing flowing in while the sink opens it (SprayShuttle). Where the family is enclosed around from some step on, some finite family without repetition containing it being closed across each step, it draws in: at arbitrarily late steps some relatum gives to the family and takes from beyond it (generation_draws_in). If finitely many relata are all there is, embodied relata do not arise at arbitrarily late steps. The premise of dissipation_ceases (a quantity that never rises and is lowered by every arising) thus follows, for the arisings of embodied members of a family dissipated on, from balance, dissipation and embodiment. Each premise is needed: two sides handing one standing back and forth generate, embodied and without end, in a closed world of two relata that is not dissipative (Shuttle); when the holder also burns a fresh fuel at every step, the handing goes on under dissipation, and every finite family without repetition containing a side is open at arbitrarily late steps, while the family of the sides, enclosed around at every step, draws in the fuel (Throughput); a relatum whose activity is not its standing arises without end in a dissipative world of one relatum (Flicker); generations giving without taking are not dissipative (Brood.not_dissipative). These requirements follow the rise of standing, not activity: in a balanced flow every rise of a condition is given to (Flow.Balances.rise_given), so it replenishes every family containing it, and where members of a family rise at arbitrarily late steps the family's replenishment recurs at arbitrarily late steps (Flow.rising_needs_replenishment). Coming to stand (the level zero before a step and positive after, Web.ComesToStand) is the rise from nothing (Web.ComesToStand.rises), given at least the new standing (Flow.Balances.standing_given, Flow.standing_needs_replenishment); a condition can rise at every step without ever coming to stand (Growing). A member of a family dissipated on rising lowers the family's stock (Flow.rise_lowers_on, Flow.standing_lowers_on), so in a family dissipated on from some step on, members neither rise nor come to stand at arbitrarily late steps (Flow.rising_ceases_on, Flow.standing_ceases_on); under dissipation, a finite family without repetition whose members rise at arbitrarily late steps is open at arbitrarily late steps (Flow.rising_opens) and, enclosed around from some step on, draws in (Flow.rising_draws_in), and if finitely many conditions are all there is, none rises at arbitrarily late steps (Flow.rising_ceases); coming to stand is a case (Web.rising_of_coming; Flow.standing_opens, Flow.standing_draws_in, Flow.standing_ceases). An embodied relatum comes to stand as it arises (Embodied.comesToStand), and the conclusions above about embodiment all follow from this, their statements unchanged. A relatum standing as a condition while active, absent at some step and active later, came to stand across some step in between (came_to_stand), possibly long before it is active: a seed is given its standing while dormant and arises later with nothing given to it (Provisioned); a relatum standing as a condition throughout wakes without end with nothing given to it, no formation taking part in its flow (Sleeper). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 流平衡依存网；家族与每步参与的关系项都是有限列表；量是自然数，单位可公度。
hypotheses.en: The flow balances the web; families and the relata taking part at each step are finite lists; amounts are natural numbers with commensurable units.

hypotheses.zh: Embodied 是对生起的关系项的表示前提：它恰在活跃时以正的水平作为条件而在。遗骸与不活跃的条件不体现；哪些关系项体现是应用义务。不体现的生起不受体现的结论约束（Flicker）。体现只用来推出生起时开始作为条件而在（Embodied.comesToStand）；关于开始作为条件而在的一般结论不需要体现，不开始作为条件而在的生起不受它们约束（Sleeper）。它在一类读法的同一对应下读：哪个条件就是哪个形成由共同的索引给出（relabel，见 life-as-condition-of-life）。
hypotheses.en: Embodied is a representational premise about the arising relata: each stands as a condition at a positive level exactly while it is active. Remains and inactive conditions are not embodied; which relata are embodied is an application duty. Arising that is not embodied is not constrained by the conclusions about embodiment (Flicker). Embodiment is used only to derive that an arising relatum comes to stand (Embodied.comesToStand); the general conclusions about coming to stand do not need it, and arising without coming to stand is not constrained by them (Sleeper). It is read under the one-kind identification: which condition is which formation is supplied by the shared index (relabel, see life-as-condition-of-life).

hypotheses.zh: 耗散（Dissipative，见 no-finite-part-bears-taking）是物理前提，只用于耗散之下的结论；它只约束有封闭有限家族的步（Spray）。generation_opens 的结论（家族不封闭）可以由与家族无关的交换满足（SprayShuttle），所以“家族须从其外汲入”另需家族被围住（Around：某个包含它的不重复有限家族跨每步封闭；generation_draws_in）。
hypotheses.en: Dissipation (Dissipative, see no-finite-part-bears-taking) is a physical premise, used only for the conclusions under dissipation; it constrains only steps at which some finite family is closed (Spray). The conclusion of generation_opens, that the family is not closed, can be met by exchange unrelated to the family (SprayShuttle), so that the family must draw in from beyond it needs, in addition, the family enclosed around (Around: some finite family without repetition containing it closed across each step; generation_draws_in).

correspondence.zh: 第五次独立审查（I3）指出，在流的形式中生起只经由它带来的取用起作用，并在其 §4 列出：一个耗散的流的定理会让生成本身而不是取用承担要求。no-finite-part-bears-taking 的界限写明结论不约束不取用的生起；life-as-condition-of-life 写明 Brood 不耗散、耗散之下的一类读法未陈述。本结果在一类关系项的读法中回答这三处。Ren 的原话是“生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向”。作者把结果读作原话中“生”与“整体”之间关系的一种形式内容：若生起的体现关系项自身就是其他关系项的条件（只在 Ren 把它读作“生”时才读作生命），每次生起都是一次补充；在耗散之下，一个被围住的有限部分中不息的生起须从其外汲入（作者的诠释，AI 论证；第七次独立审查 K1 更正了此前“不能由任何有限的部分独自承担”的说法：耗散空成立时，有限的部分可以独自承担生成，而结论由与它无关的交换满足，见 SprayShuttle）；它不替代 Ren 的原话，也不推出它是好的。实际的生命是否体现、实际的量是否耗散，是对应与经验问题。
correspondence.en: The fifth independent review (I3) found that in the flow form arising contributes only the uptake it brings, and listed in its §4 that a dissipative flow theorem would make generation itself, rather than uptake, carry the requirement. The boundary of no-finite-part-bears-taking says its conclusion does not constrain arising without taking; life-as-condition-of-life says Brood is not dissipative and the one-kind reading under dissipation is not stated. This result answers all three in the one-kind reading. Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). The author reads the result as one formal content of the relation between 生 and the whole in those words: where an arising embodied relatum is itself a condition of others (read as 生 only under Ren's reading), every arising is a replenishment, and under dissipation unceasing arising in a finite part enclosed around draws in from beyond it (the author's interpretation, an AI argument; K1 of the seventh independent review corrected the earlier “cannot be borne by any finite part alone”: where dissipation holds vacuously, a finite part can bear generation alone while exchange unrelated to it meets the conclusion, see SprayShuttle); it does not replace Ren's words and does not show that it is good. Whether actual lives are embodied, and whether actual quantities dissipate, are questions of correspondence and evidence.

detail.zh: 复用一类关系项的读法、Embodied、SelfBearing 与 Brood；把体现的关系项经由给予而生起推进为“生成即补充”。
detail.en: Reuses the one-kind reading, Embodied, SelfBearing and Brood; carries embodied arising through giving on to generation as replenishment.

output.zh: 体现的关系项只经由给予而生起。
output.en: An embodied relatum arises only as it is given to.

input.zh: 体现的生起补充家族，在耗散之下降低封闭家族的存量。
input.en: An embodied arising replenishes the family and, under dissipation, lowers a closed family's stock.

detail.zh: 复用 ClosedAt、DissipatesOn、Dissipative、runs_down 与 Frontier 的燃料；新增 DissipatesOn.takes_of_gives；把该记录关于取用的结论推到体现的生起。
detail.en: Reuses ClosedAt, DissipatesOn, Dissipative, runs_down and Frontier's fuels; adds DissipatesOn.takes_of_gives; carries that record's conclusion about taking on to embodied arising.

output.zh: 被耗散的家族至少下降其取用者的数目。
output.en: A family dissipated on falls by at least its number of takers.

input.zh: 体现成员的生起使封闭家族下降。
input.en: An embodied member's arising makes a closed family fall.

detail.zh: 复用流、平衡、取用、给予、补充、Acting 与有限和的引理。
detail.en: Reuses flows, balance, taking, giving, replenishment, Acting and the lemmas on finite totals.

output.zh: 平衡：水平的变化恰是给予与取用之差。
output.en: Balance: a change of level is exactly what is given less what is taken.

input.zh: 生起时的水平全由给予承担。
input.en: The standing an embodied relatum arises with is all given.

output.zh: 从不上升的量只下降有限次。
output.en: A quantity that never rises falls only finitely often.

input.zh: 封闭家族的存量从不上升，每次体现的生起都使它下降。
input.en: A closed family's stock never rises and every embodied arising in it lowers it.

detail.zh: 回答第五次审查 I3：该记录的流形式中生起只经由取用起作用；这里体现的生起本身承担要求。该记录的 dissipation_ceases 所设的物理前提，对封闭家族中体现成员的生起被推出。
detail.en: Answers I3 of the fifth review: in that record's flow form arising works only through uptake, while here embodied arising carries the requirement itself. The physical premise supplied to that record's dissipation_ceases is derived for the arisings of embodied members of a closed family.

detail.zh: 整体与部分：在耗散之下，体现的生成不由任何有限的关系项家族独自承担。整体的演绎仍开放。
detail.en: Whole and parts: under dissipation embodied generation is not borne by any finite family of relata alone. The whole deduction remains open.

detail.zh: 活动越过支持时，储备推迟终结而不逃脱终结；水平越过活动由本记录的 came_to_stand、Provisioned 与 Sleeper 陈述，两者回答本记录先前的下一步（活动与水平不同步）。
detail.en: Where activity outlasts support, a reserve defers the end without escaping it; standing outlasting activity is stated here by came_to_stand, Provisioned and Sleeper, together answering this record's earlier next step (activity and standing out of step).

detail.zh: 局部规律用 laws-of-one-step 的 Flow.BalancesOn；这是证明上的复用。记录之间不设依存边，因为 laws-of-one-step 经其依存链依存于本记录。
detail.en: The local laws use Flow.BalancesOn of laws-of-one-step; this is reuse in the proof. No dependency edge joins the records, since laws-of-one-step depends on this one through its chain of dependencies.

detail.zh: 没有耗散，体现的生成可以在封闭的有限世界中不息（Shuttle.shuttle）：持有者归还它所取，两方轮流生起。
detail.en: Without dissipation, embodied generation can be unceasing in a closed finite world (Shuttle.shuttle): the holder gives back what it takes and the two sides arise in turn.

detail.zh: 不体现的生起不需要补充：Flicker 在一个关系项的耗散世界中不息地生起（Flicker.flicker）；两类读法中没有形成体现（roles_not_embodied）。
detail.en: Arising that is not embodied needs no replenishment: Flicker arises without end in a dissipative world of one relatum (Flicker.flicker); in the two-kind reading no formation is embodied (roles_not_embodied).

detail.zh: 前提相容并且结论可达：Throughput 平衡、耗散，两方体现并承担自身，各自在任意晚的步生起；包含一方的每个有限家族在任意晚的步打开（Throughput.frontier），两方的家族每步被两方与所燃的燃料围住（Throughput.around），在任意晚的步给予家族的一方从燃料取用（Throughput.draws_in）。Brood 不耗散（Brood.not_dissipative）。
detail.en: The premises are consistent and the conclusion attained: Throughput balances and is dissipative, both sides are embodied and bear on themselves, and each arises at arbitrarily late steps; every finite family containing a side opens at arbitrarily late steps (Throughput.frontier), the family of the sides is enclosed around at every step by the sides and the fuel burnt (Throughput.around), and at arbitrarily late steps the side giving to it takes from the fuel (Throughput.draws_in). Brood is not dissipative (Brood.not_dissipative).

detail.zh: generation_opens 的结论可以由与家族无关的交换满足（SprayShuttle.spray_shuttle、opens_anyway）：两方如 Shuttle 来回传递，一个汇每步从一个辅助关系项取一份又还给它；汇与不断新的关系项交换，没有一步被封闭，耗散空成立；两方在任意晚的步生起，给予家族的关系项只从家族取用，汇从不与两方交换，家族的存量恒为一，而家族从任何一步起都不封闭；没有一步围住它（第七次独立审查 K1）。
detail.en: The conclusion of generation_opens can be met by exchange unrelated to the family (SprayShuttle.spray_shuttle, opens_anyway): two sides hand one standing back and forth as in Shuttle, while a sink takes one unit from an auxiliary relatum at every step and gives it back; the sink exchanges with ever new relata, so no step is enclosed and dissipation holds vacuously; the sides arise at arbitrarily late steps, every relatum giving to the family takes only from it, the sink never exchanges with the sides, and the family's stock is one at every step, yet the family is not closed from any step on; no step encloses it around (seventh independent review, K1).

detail.zh: 从休眠中醒来是生起而不开始作为条件而在：一个关系项始终以水平一作为条件而在、在奇数步醒来；它的流中没有形成参与，流平衡，耗散空成立，Dependent 成立，生成不息而没有任何给予（Sleeper.sleeper）。
detail.en: Waking from dormancy is arising without coming to stand: a relatum stands at level one throughout and wakes at odd steps; no formation takes part in its flow, which balances and is vacuously dissipative, Dependent holds, and generation is unceasing with nothing given (Sleeper.sleeper).

detail.zh: 水平可以早于活动：父代在第 0 步给予种子一单位，种子休眠一步后活跃；它在休眠时开始作为条件而在、被给予它的水平，在第 1 步生起时没有任何给予（Provisioned.provisioned）。
detail.en: Standing can come before activity: a parent gives a seed one unit at step 0 and the seed is active after one dormant step; it comes to stand while dormant, given its standing, and is given nothing at step 1 when it arises (Provisioned.provisioned).

limitations.zh: 不含伦理谓词；关于体现的结论只约束体现的关系项的生起，不体现的生起不受约束；一般的结论约束开始作为条件而在，不约束从休眠中醒来（Sleeper）；Embodied 是表示前提，遗骸、种子库与不活跃的条件不体现，种子库与休眠由 came_to_stand、Provisioned 与 Sleeper 陈述；耗散是物理前提，单位可公度；generation_opens 只约束在一个有限家族中复现的生成，它的结论可以由与家族无关的交换满足（SprayShuttle），汲入只在家族被围住时陈述（generation_draws_in），不断生起新的关系项（如 Brood）不在任何有限家族中复现；“有限”指有限的关系项家族；见证都是最小见证，Shuttle 中持有者取用自身的水平，不读作汲取；新名称最终由 Ren 定。
limitations.en: Contains no ethical predicate; the conclusions about embodiment constrain only the arising of embodied relata, and arising that is not embodied is unconstrained; the general conclusions constrain coming to stand, not waking from dormancy (Sleeper); Embodied is a representational premise, and remains, seed banks and inactive conditions are not embodied, seed banks and dormancy being stated through came_to_stand, Provisioned and Sleeper; dissipation is a physical premise with commensurable units; generation_opens constrains only generation recurring in one finite family, its conclusion can be met by exchange unrelated to the family (SprayShuttle), and drawing in is stated only for a family enclosed around (generation_draws_in), and arising of ever new relata (as in Brood) recurs in no finite family; “finite” means a finite family of relata; the witnesses are minimal, and in Shuttle the holder takes its own standing without that being read as drawing; the final choice of names is Ren's.
